case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

You described your cost environment around the alloy surcharge and input prices, and that is where we start. The two lines below show the surcharge and bar prices moving down in recent months, and our own purchase history with you shows the same.

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On bar prices:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

On our purchase history:
Our orders of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled with you were placed at EUR 5.45 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011523-10), EUR 5.33 on 2025-06-05 (po:4500012560-10), EUR 5.24 on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013482-10) and EUR 5.45 on 2026-09-24 (po:4500014455-10): the price has not risen.

Against this background, Option A is the package we can approve: it gives you a longer contract term and a price that matches the cost lines above.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.99; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.96; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.95; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As you will need to take this to a pricing committee, here is a short paragraph for the person who decides. Option A gives Edelstahl-Service Donautal a firm contract term on a recurring part, a clear unit price with no index mechanics to administer, and a customer who will stand behind the order once it is confirmed. Could you please take Option A to that person?

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

We are glad to supply whatever your approval needs on our side.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Furthermore, we checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. While we acknowledge the PPI-C2431 movement, our alloy material is covered at fixed agreements until March 2027, meaning recent index drops do not reduce our expenses. We cannot offer a fixed price for a 24-month term, so we must include an AS-14404 index clause. 

Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Building on your Option C, we propose €5.32 with 45 days payment and a 24-month contract, and our team will address your request for a cost breakdown.

Our current Angebot provides a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

As an alternative, we offer a price of €5.32 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.32 per unit.

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

You said that your alloy is covered at fixed prices and that falling indices do not reach your cost. Our options answer exactly that: through the index clause on the alloy surcharge, we carry the movement above the deadband, so your base price no longer needs a risk premium.

Option A is the package we can approve. It combines the index clause with the longest payment term and a contract term that gives you planning certainty, and it is the one that fits delivery performance as it stands:

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 88.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70710@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.02; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.99; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.98; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As you may need to take this to a pricing committee, here is a paragraph your decision-maker can approve as it stands: Option A gives Edelstahl-Service Donautal a longer contract term with a clear volume relationship, protection against alloy surcharge movements through an index clause that we carry above the deadband, and a base price that no longer has to carry that risk. We would pay every invoice on its agreed due date.

Could you please take Option A to the person who decides? If the committee needs anything further to approve it, tell us and we will provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We have reviewed the delivery performance data you cited; while verified, it does not warrant a price reduction. Building on your Option C, we propose a unit price of EUR 5.29 with 45 days payment and a 24-month contract. This represents a further concession on our part while maintaining the index clause to manage the alloy surcharge risk.

To clearly summarize our Angebot for you: we offer a price of €5.29 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value your business and are always keen to work together to find the right solutions for your supply requirements.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Logistics: We are well loaded. Our Lieferzeit is 10 days, and with overtime we can deliver in 10 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. 

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot), so we kindly ask you to decide. We are pleased to present our offer of a price of €5.29 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
